description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for configuring and transforming Vite build setup within the Playwright component testing framework, including directory resolution, endpoint configuration, dynamic config creation, component population, and code transformation for React detection and import injection.

methods.name: resolveDirs
methods.description: Resolves component directories based on configuration and project settings.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs server endpoint configuration from full project config.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vite configuration object based on directories, project config, and support for JSX.

methods.name: populateComponentsFromTests
methods.description: Populates a component registry with imported component info from test data.

methods.name: hasJSComponents
methods.description: Checks if any components in the list are JavaScript components based on their import paths.

methods.name: transformIndexFile
methods.description: Transforms index files to inject React import statements or component import code based on file content and type.

methods.name: frameworkConfig
methods.description: Retrieves framework-specific configuration from the full project config.
